name: convention-default-export-through-module-exports
description: A value assigned to module.exports is the default export the row reads, so the property it sets moves the directory. The fixture assumes the analyzer carries a row named react-router for the package @react-router/dev, holding the installed version in its range, whose entry globs name root.ts below an app directory that defaults to app and that the appDirectory property of react-router.config.ts moves.
